gloss: facial beauty; beautiful face; facial care; facial treatment

definitions.gloss: facial beauty; beautiful face; facial care; facial treatment

examples.japanese: {美顔|びがん}{器|き}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a facial beauty device.

examples.japanese: {美顔|びがん}ローラーで{顔|かお}のマッサージをする。
examples.english: I massage my face with a facial roller.

examples.japanese: エステサロンで{美顔|びがん}コースを{受|う}けたら、{肌|はだ}がつるつるになった。
examples.english: After receiving a facial treatment course at a beauty salon, my skin became silky smooth.

notes:
Composed of {美|び} (beauty) + {顔|がん} (face). Commonly used as a prefix in beauty product and skincare vocabulary. The word emphasizes both the state of having a beautiful face and the practice of facial care.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {美顔|びがん}{器|き}: facial beauty device
- {美顔|びがん}ローラー: facial roller
- {美顔|びがん}エステ: facial esthetic treatment
- {美顔|びがん}{効果|こうか}: facial beauty effect
- {美顔|びがん}マッサージ: facial beauty massage

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {美肌|びはだ}: beautiful skin — focuses on skin quality rather than the face overall
- {美容|びよう}: beauty, cosmetics — broader term covering all aspects of personal beauty care
- フェイシャル: facial (treatment) — loanword used specifically for professional treatments
